_comment: SUP-16: Dependabot (.github/dependabot.yml) owns gomod, npm, pip, github-actions and Dockerfile FROM bumps. Renovate is scoped to ONLY the custom digest manager below, which bumps the @sha256:/digest: image pins in the Compose stacks and Helm values that Dependabot's docker manager does not track — so the two bots never overlap.

customManagers.description: SUP-16: keep digest-pinned images current in Compose + Helm values + Dockerfiles
